changes.was: Your to-do list just struck out.
changes.now: Your to-do list just met its match.
changes.why: Baseball idiom "struck out" is not widely understood in Nigeria, where football dominates.
Brief requires stating the 14-day trial length wherever 'free' appears.

changes.was: Your to-do list just struck out.
changes.now: Your to-do list just got sorted.
changes.why: Baseball idiom doesn't translate; replaced with the everyday British word for something dealt with.

changes.was: Kin rebooks the dentist you've dodged since March, chases the refund
changes.now: Kin rebooks the dentist, sorts the MOT, chases the refund
changes.why: Swapped the joke about dodging NHS dentist appointments for a recognisable, neutral UK chore to avoid political flippancy.

changes.now: Then go and do something better.
changes.why: British English keeps 'and' in 'go and do'; 'go do' reads American.
Brief requires stating the 14-day trial length wherever 'free' appears.

changes.was: Your to-do list just struck out.
changes.now: Your to-do list just ran out of excuses.
changes.why: Baseball idiom "struck out" isn't understood locally and misreads as "crossed out".
WhatsApp group is the everyday local term for a group chat.
Free offers must state the trial length per advertising standards and the brief's mandatory.

flags.text: Check: The CTA says 'Try Kin free' without stating the 14-day trial length required by the mandatory whenever 'free' appears.

Check: 'chases the refund' implies Kin accesses bank or payment details to get money back. NG-S3 says financial claims like this raise fraud suspicion unless purpose and control are clearly explained.
Check: 'chases' is called out as a word that may read differently across Nigerian regions; the snapshot has no guidance on this, so confirm it lands well nationally.
Check: 'Try Kin free for 14 days.' states the trial length but not what happens when it ends (price, auto-renewal). The rule requires the length and what follows to sit together.

Check: 'finds a time that works for the whole WhatsApp group' implies Kin reads or coordinates within a group chat. This touches the sensitivity around apps accessing personal messages, so purpose and control should be crystal clear.

Check: The body doesn't spell out what data Kin needs to access to rebook appointments, chase refunds, or read the group chat. Confirm this doesn't overstate or obscure what's actually collected under POPIA.
